title: Northbridge Home Delivery Transition Supply: Standing Days-Supply Rule (Formulary Benefit)
content:
**Standing rule.** A home-delivery transition supply under the Formulary Benefit runs for the formulary's maximum days supply for one transition fill. It is never less than zero, never more than that maximum, and it is taken as a whole number of days.

**What enters the figure.** One input enters the figure: the maximum days supply for one transition fill on the member's Northbridge formulary. The supply is that maximum, held between zero and the maximum and expressed in whole days.

*Worked figure (hypothetical maximum).* On a formulary whose maximum for one transition fill is 30 days, the home-delivery transition supply is 30 days.
